$comment: Pilot: deep dive. Decomposition → distribution → raw rows. Two extra dropdown filters on the rail. Change only the tree's 'by' list, the scatter axes and the detail columns.
name: Pilot-Deepdive

Headline Tree.en: VAR t = VALUES ( '매장'[권역] ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) RETURN "Sales " & FORMAT ( [매출] / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  Top region: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '매장'[권역], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ), [매출] ), "0%" ) & "  ·  click + next to a bar to drill one level"
Headline Tree.ko: VAR t = VALUES ( '매장'[권역] ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) RETURN "매출 " & FORMAT ( [매출] / [Unit Scale Big], IF ( [Unit Scale Big] = 1E8, "0.0", "#,0" ) ) & [Unit Suffix Big] & "  ·  권역 1위 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '매장'[권역], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ), [매출] ), "0%" ) & "  ·  막대 옆 +를 눌러 기준을 골라 한 단계씩 내려가기"

Headline Discount.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '제품'[제품명] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR top5 = TOPN ( 5, t, [평균할인율], DESC ) RETURN "Margin of the 5 most-discounted products " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], top5 ), "0.0%" ) & "  ·  all other products " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], EXCEPT ( t, top5 ) ), "0.0%" )
Headline Discount.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '제품'[제품명] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR top5 = TOPN ( 5, t, [평균할인율], DESC ) RETURN "할인율 상위 5개 제품의 이익률 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], top5 ), "0.0%" ) & "  ·  나머지 제품 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], EXCEPT ( t, top5 ) ), "0.0%" )

Headline Detail.en: FORMAT ( [주문건수], "#,0" ) & " orders  ·  Sales " & FORMAT ( [매출] / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & "  ·  click a header to sort, right-click a row to copy"
Headline Detail.ko: "주문 " & FORMAT ( [주문건수], "#,0" ) & "건  ·  매출 " & FORMAT ( [매출] / [Unit Scale Big], IF ( [Unit Scale Big] = 1E8, "0.0", "#,0" ) ) & [Unit Suffix Big] & "  ·  머리글을 눌러 정렬, 행을 오른쪽 클릭해 복사"

Headline Bridge.expr: VAR _t = ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( '카테고리'[카테고리] ), "D", [전년 대비 증감] ) VAR _up = TOPN ( 1, _t, [D], DESC ) VAR _dn = TOPN ( 1, _t, [D], ASC ) VAR _g = [전년 대비 증감] RETURN "Year on year " & FORMAT ( _g / [Unit Scale], "▲#,0.0;▼#,0.0;0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & " · most added: " & CONCATENATEX ( _up, '카테고리'[카테고리] ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _up, [D] ) / [Unit Scale], "▲#,0.0;▼#,0.0;0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & " · most lost: " & CONCATENATEX ( _dn, '카테고리'[카테고리] ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( _dn, [D] ) / [Unit Scale], "▲#,0.0;▼#,0.0;0" ) & [Unit Suffix]

Headline Profile.expr: VAR _t = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( '매장'[매장명] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( '매장' ) ) VAR _1 = CONCATENATEX ( TOPN ( 1, _t, [매출], DESC ), '매장'[매장명] ) VAR _2 = CONCATENATEX ( EXCEPT ( TOPN ( 2, _t, [매출], DESC ), TOPN ( 1, _t, [매출], DESC ) ), '매장'[매장명] ) VAR _3 = CONCATENATEX ( EXCEPT ( TOPN ( 3, _t, [매출], DESC ), TOPN ( 2, _t, [매출], DESC ) ), '매장'[매장명] ) RETURN "Top three stores by sales: " & _1 & ", " & _2 & ", " & _3 & " · every axis scaled 0-100 across all " & FORMAT ( COUNTROWS ( _t ), "#,0" ) & " stores"

Headline Spread.expr: VAR _n = COUNTROWS ( CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( '매장'[매장명] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( '매장' ) ) ) VAR _skew = [평균 중앙값 차이] VAR _o = [이상치 매장 수] RETURN "Mean " & FORMAT ( [매장 매출 평균] / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & " sits " & FORMAT ( _skew / [Unit Scale], "#,0.0" ) & [Unit Suffix] & " above the median across " & FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) & " stores" & IF ( _o > 0, " · " & FORMAT ( _o, "#,0" ) & " sit outside 1.5 × IQR", "" )

Headline Corr.expr: VAR _t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '지표쌍'[쌍] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [쌍 상관] ) ) VAR _top = TOPN ( 1, _t, [쌍 상관 세기], DESC ) VAR _r = MAXX ( _top, [쌍 상관] ) VAR _n = COUNTROWS ( CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( '매장'[매장명] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( '매장' ) ) ) RETURN "Strongest pair: " & CONCATENATEX ( _top, '지표쌍'[쌍], "; " ) & " at r = " & FORMAT ( _r, "+0.00;-0.00" ) & "  ·  " & FORMAT ( COUNTROWS ( _t ), "#,0" ) & " pairs over " & FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) & " stores"
